faq.q: What makes a good mouse lemur name?
faq.a: A good name matches personality, is easy to pronounce, and ideally 1-2 syllables.

faq.q: Should I name based on appearance?
faq.a: Yes! Distinctive features make wonderful naming inspiration.

faq.q: Can I use a human name?
faq.a: Absolutely. Human names are popular and make bonds feel more personal.
Shortlist 3-5 favorites, test them over several days.
Names ending in vowel sounds, especially 'ee', work best for recognition.

faq.q: How do I pick the right name for my Mouse Lemur?
faq.a: Start by observing your Mouse Lemur for a few days — their personality, behaviors, and quirks will guide you toward the perfect name. Say candidate names aloud and notice which ones feel natural. The 'backdoor test' — calling the name from outside — is a reliable measure. Trust your instincts: the name that makes you smile is the right one.

faq.q: What are some unique naming ideas for Mouse Lemurs?
faq.a: Look to the Mouse Lemur's natural habitat, distinctive physical features, or behavioral traits for inspiration. Draw from mythology, nature, literature, or your favorite stories. Consider names from languages connected to the animal's geographic origin. The most unique names often come from personal experiences and unexpected sources.

faq.q: Can I change my Mouse Lemur's name if needed?
faq.a: Yes — Mouse Lemurs can learn new names at any age. Use the new name consistently with positive reinforcement: treats, affection, and play. Most Mouse Lemurs fully adapt within 1-2 weeks. This is common with rescue or rehomed animals who benefit from a name that has no negative associations.
